description: A clock generator with four dividers and multipliers, a time signature, and an audio metronome click

params.text: Sets the time signature the metronome counts in, from 2/4 up to 15/8
Sets the level of the audio click, 0 to 200%
Sets how much of each main clock pulse is high, 0% to 100%
Restarts the clock and the metronome from the first beat of the bar
Divides or multiplies the main clock for that row, from a 256th of it to 256 times it, with x1 in the centre
Sets how much of that row's pulse is high, 0% to 100%, or the swing amount when 'Trig/Swing on Div' is ticked for that row

inputs.text: An external clock to follow instead of the BPM knob, counted off against the PPQN resolution set on the menu
A trigger here restarts the clock and the metronome from the first beat of the bar
A trigger here starts or stops the clock, as the RUN button does

outputs.text: The main clock, at the tempo and pulse width set
A pulse when a reset happens, and on run or stop where 'Pulse to RST out' is ticked
That row's divided or multiplied clock
A 1ms pulse on every beat while the clock is running
A 1ms pulse on every bar while the clock is running

notes: the BPM display is coloured by where the tempo comes from: yellow for the BPM knob and blue for an external clock at the EXT jack.
the algorithm varies the length of individual clock pulses so that the number of beats in a minute comes out exact, so the pulses are not all the same length.
right-clicking a div/mult display picks the division or multiplication directly, without turning the knob.
menu: Trig/Swing on Div #1 — makes that row send a 1ms trigger instead of a gate, and turns its PW knob into a swing control that delays the even pulses of a multiplication
Trig/Swing on Div #2 — makes that row send a 1ms trigger instead of a gate, and turns its PW knob into a swing control that delays the even pulses of a multiplication
Trig/Swing on Div #3 — makes that row send a 1ms trigger instead of a gate, and turns its PW knob into a swing control that delays the even pulses of a multiplication
Trig/Swing on Div #4 — makes that row send a 1ms trigger instead of a gate, and turns its PW knob into a swing control that delays the even pulses of a multiplication
Resolution — under the 'External Clock' heading, sets how many pulses per quarter note the EXT jack is sending: 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16 or 24
Reset Bar — under the 'On Run' and 'On Stop' headings, restarts the metronome from the first beat of the bar at that moment
Pulse to RST out — under the 'On Run' and 'On Stop' headings, sends a pulse from the RST output at that moment
Beat pulse also on Bar — copies every BAR pulse onto the BEAT output as well
Click Settings — a submenu choosing between the three built-in click pairs, Standard, Click1 and Click2, or Custom with a wav file loaded for the beat and another for the bar
